children.name: Meandrina meandrites
children.description: Meandrina meandrites, commonly known as maze coral, is a species of colonial stony coral in the family Meandrinidae.

children.name: Dichocoenia stokesii
children.description: Dichocoenia is a monotypic genus of stony coral in the family Meandrinidae. It is represented by a single species, Dichocoenia stokesii, which is commonly known as pineapple coral, elliptical star coral, or pancake star coral. It is mostly found in the Caribbean Sea and the western Atlantic Ocean. Dichocoenia stokesii has irregular calyces and its form can be either a massive, hemispherical hump or a flat, platform-like structure.

children.name: Dendrogyra cylindrus
children.description: Pillar coral (Dendrogyra cylindrus) is a hard coral (order Scleractinia) found in the western Atlantic Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.
